Guided by Magnus Group LLC, the Chemistry Research Conference 2027 brings together academic chemists, industrial R&D scientists, medicinal-chemistry specialists, computational modellers, analytical experts, chemistry educators, and policy voices for three days of scholarly programme, cross-sector conversation, and translational discussion covering the full landscape of chemical science. Sessions traverse pharmaceutical and medicinal chemistry, organic and inorganic chemistry, analytical and bioanalytical chemistry, materials and nanochemistry, polymer chemistry, catalysis and chemical engineering, energy and electrochemistry, environmental and green chemistry, biochemistry and chemical biology, theoretical and computational chemistry, industrial chemistry, synthetic biology and designer molecules, physical chemistry, food and nutritional chemistry, natural-products chemistry, and AI and machine learning across all chemistry disciplines. Chemists, academic researchers, and industry practitioners are respectfully invited to contribute original findings, method papers, and topical reviews for oral or poster presentation. Delegates and listeners may complete registration on the International Chemistry Conference 2027 portal, joining either on-site at NH Villa Carpegna or remotely from any country - both options are equally supported by the hybrid format. Reach us at: E-mail: [email protected] Phone: +1 (702) 988-2320 WhatsApp: +1 (540) 709-1879 Website: https://chemistryworldconference.com/ • Pharmaceutical & Medicinal Chemistry • Organic Chemistry • Inorganic Chemistry • Analytical & Bioanalytical Chemistry • Materials & Nanochemistry • Polymer Chemistry • AI & Machine Learning in Chemistry • Catalysis & Chemical Engineering • Energy & Electrochemical Chemistry • Environmental & Green Chemistry • Biochemistry & Chemical Biology • Theoretical & Computational Chemistry • Industrial Chemistry • Synthetic Biology & Designer Molecules • Physical Chemistry • Food & Nutritional Chemistry • Natural Products Chemistry

CHES 2026 is the 2026 edition of CHES, the long-running conference series on cryptographic hardware and embedded systems organized under the IACR. The conference serves researchers and practitioners working at the intersection of cryptography, hardware design, implementation security, and embedded computing. The 2026 program follows the journal-conference model through TCHES and continues CHES’s central role in advancing practical and implementation-oriented cryptographic research. Cryptographic hardware; embedded security; side-channel analysis and countermeasures; fault attacks and fault tolerance; hardware implementations of cryptographic algorithms; secure architectures and trusted hardware; lightweight cryptography; post-quantum cryptography implementations; evaluation methodologies, tools and benchmarks for secure hardware and embedded cryptographic systems.

postings.conferenceName: ACM Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: ACM Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems
postings.conferenceText: CHI 2026 is the ACM Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems, the flagship international conference in human-computer interaction. CHI brings together researchers, practitioners, students, and industry leaders from around the world to present influential work across the full breadth of HCI theory, method, design, and practice. The 2026 edition will be held in Barcelona and continues CHI’s role as a central venue for innovative and high-impact research on interactive systems and human experience. Human-computer interaction research across all areas of HCI; papers, posters, interactive demos, panels, workshops, meet-ups, mentoring, and journal-based contributions; HCI theory, method, design, accessibility, inclusivity, and applications; novel interactive technologies and user studies; empirical, design, engineering, and interdisciplinary contributions to HCI.

postings.conferenceName: Conference on Innovative Data Systems Research 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: Conference on Innovative Data Systems Research
postings.conferenceText: CIDR 2026 is the Conference on Innovative Data Systems Research, a systems-oriented venue complementary to mainstream database conferences such as SIGMOD and VLDB. CIDR emphasizes innovative, visionary, and often risky ideas in data systems architecture, practical systems-building insight, and provocative position papers. The conference is known for its single-track format and strong interaction between academic and industrial data systems researchers. Innovative data systems architecture; systems-building experience and insight; experimental studies of data management systems; provocative position statements; novel approaches to data systems usage and architecture; practical and visionary work in modern data platforms.

postings.conferenceName: 35th International ACM Conference on Information and Knowledge Management 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 35th International ACM Conference on Information and Knowledge Management
postings.conferenceText: CIKM 2026 is the 35th International ACM Conference on Information and Knowledge Management. The conference is a premier forum for research on how information is represented, retrieved, organized, integrated, and used at scale, spanning information retrieval, knowledge management, data mining, AI, and practical intelligent systems. The 2026 edition in Rome continues CIKM’s long-standing role in linking foundational methods with real-world data and knowledge applications. Information retrieval; knowledge management; search and recommendation; knowledge graphs and representation; data mining and analytics; web and social media data; machine learning and AI for information systems; natural language processing for information access; human-centered information interaction; trustworthy, fair and efficient information systems.

postings.conferenceName: 3rd Edition of International Cancer & Immuno-Oncology Conference 2027
postings.conferenceText: Hosted by Magnus Group LLC, the 3rd Edition of International Cancer & Immuno-Oncology Conference will convene global oncology researchers in Singapore and Online on March 15-17, 2027 (hybrid) - three days of precision oncology, immunotherapy, ADCs, liquid biopsy, AI in oncology, and supportive care and survivorship. Genitourinary Cancers, Immuno-Oncology Frontiers, Cell & Gene Therapy in Oncology, Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADCs), Precision Oncology & Biomarkers, Liquid Biopsy & MRDEarly Detection & Screening, AI, Imaging & Decision Support, Trials Design & Innovation, Real-World Data & Outcomes, Peri-/Neoadjuvant Strategies, Treatment Resistance & Sequencing, Supportive Care & Survivorship, Nursing & Allied Oncology Practice, Health Economics, Access & Policy,

postings.conferenceName: IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing 2025
postings.conferenceSeries: IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing
postings.conferenceText: IEEE CLOUD is the flagship conference of the IEEE World Congress on SERVICES for innovative cloud computing research. The conference focuses on the full lifecycle of Everything-as-a-Service paradigms, from modeling and design to operation, delivery, monitoring, and scaling across cloud-to-edge settings. As part of the broader SERVICES congress, CLOUD also sits within a larger ecosystem of work on IoT, intelligent computing, big data, blockchain, security, trustworthiness, and services applications. Cloud computing; Everything as a Service (XaaS); modeling, designing, developing, publishing, monitoring, managing, operating, delivering, and scaling cloud and edge services; services computing; IoT; intelligent computing; machine learning; big data; blockchain; performance, security, privacy, dependability, trustworthiness, and cost-effectiveness in service systems.

postings.conferenceName: China Materials Conference 2025 2025
postings.conferenceText: China Materials Conference 2025 is the annual academic meeting of the Chinese Materials Research Society and one of the major broad-scope materials meetings in China. The 2025 edition will be held in Xiamen and the official site describes it as the 24th occurrence of the conference series. The meeting is structured to serve the national and international materials community through plenary and invited reports, thematic sessions, youth forums, special forums on new materials, education-related sessions, journal forums, and exhibition activities. The program is organized around major materials domains and is intended to promote exchange on current advances in materials science, engineering, innovation, and industrial application. The official program highlights major themes including energy materials, environmental materials, advanced structural materials, functional materials, and materials design, preparation and evaluation. The conference also includes youth-focused forums, new materials special forums, materials education activities, academic journal forums, and exhibition or industry-facing sessions related to contemporary materials science and engineering.

postings.conferenceName: The 15th Global Conference on Materials Science and Engineering 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: The 15th Global Conference on Materials Science and Engineering
postings.conferenceText: CMSE 2026, the 15th Global Conference on Materials Science and Engineering, is an established international conference series focused on materials science, engineering, and related technologies. The 2026 edition will be held in Macao, China and is presented as a premier academic platform for researchers from universities, research institutes, and industry. The conference series was launched in 2012 and the official site highlights its multi-edition history and broad international participation. The event aims to support communication on cutting-edge advances in materials research, facilitate exchange between different branches of the field, and provide a forum for publishing and presenting new work in modern materials science and engineering. Materials science and engineering; advanced materials; metals, ceramics, polymers and composites; nanomaterials; electronic, magnetic and optical materials; biomaterials; energy and environmental materials; processing and manufacturing; simulation and modeling; characterization and testing; applied mechanics and engineering aspects related to materials science; and broader emerging topics included in the CMSE technical program.

postings.conferenceName: The 32nd International Computing and Combinatorics Conference 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: The 32nd International Computing and Combinatorics Conference
postings.conferenceText: COCOON is a long-running international conference on computing and combinatorics, bringing together work in algorithms, complexity, combinatorics, and related theoretical areas. The 2026 edition is hosted by Nanyang Technological University in Singapore. The conference continues the series’ role as a forum for foundational computer science research while providing a venue for invited talks, accepted papers, and interaction across the theoretical computing community. Computing and combinatorics; algorithms and complexity; combinatorial methods in computer science; conference papers, invited speakers, and theoretical computer science contributions.

postings.conferenceName: CogSci 2026 2026
postings.conferenceText: CogSci 2026 is the annual conference of the Cognitive Science Society and will be held in Rio de Janeiro. The conference brings together researchers across the many disciplines that contribute to cognitive science, and the 2026 edition will be run in a fully synchronous hybrid format with both in-person and virtual participation. The event emphasizes broad participation and interdisciplinary exchange, with accessibility measures including translation support for selected sessions and extended on-demand access to presentations. Cognitive science research across disciplines; human cognition, language, learning, reasoning, perception, and decision making; computational and experimental approaches; interdisciplinary studies connecting psychology, linguistics, AI, neuroscience, philosophy, education, and related areas.

postings.conferenceName: The 31st International Conference on Computational Linguistics 2025
postings.conferenceSeries: The 31st International Conference on Computational Linguistics
postings.conferenceText: COLING 2025 is the 31st International Conference on Computational Linguistics, a major international conference devoted to research in computational linguistics and natural language processing. The event gathers the community around language understanding, generation, resources, models, and practical systems, and the 2025 edition is hosted in Abu Dhabi, UAE with main conference participation on site and additional virtual presentation sessions after the main event. The conference site includes calls for main papers, system demonstrations, tutorials, workshop proposals, industry activities and volunteer participation. Its technical scope covers computational linguistics, NLP methods and resources, language technologies, multilingual processing, information extraction, semantics, dialogue, generation, and applied language AI.

postings.conferenceName: 22nd EAI International Conference on Collaborative Computing: Networking, Applications and Worksharing 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 22nd EAI International Conference on Collaborative Computing: Networking, Applications and Worksharing
postings.conferenceText: CollaborateCom 2026 is the 22nd EAI International Conference on Collaborative Computing: Networking, Applications and Worksharing. The conference provides a forum for research on communication, collaboration, and cooperative digital environments, connecting networking foundations with application and platform design. The 2026 edition in Hong Kong continues the series’ emphasis on technologies that support collaborative applications, distributed teamwork, and intelligent networked services. Collaborative computing systems; networked applications and services; worksharing platforms; cooperative and social computing; distributed communication systems; cloud and edge support for collaboration; security and privacy in collaborative environments; multimedia and real-time collaboration; AI-enabled collaboration tools and applications.

postings.conferenceName: Conference on Language Modeling 2026
postings.conferenceText: COLM 2026 is the Conference on Language Modeling, an academic venue focused on the study of language modeling in the broadest sense. The conference aims to build a research community that brings together expertise from different disciplines to understand, improve, and critique the development of language model technology. The 2026 edition will take place in San Francisco as a single-track event with invited talks, oral presentations, posters, and workshops. Language modeling broadly defined; understanding, improving, and critiquing language model technology; interdisciplinary research on modern language models; invited talks, oral presentations, posters, and workshop discussions related to LM methods and impacts.

postings.conferenceName: 39th Annual Conference on Learning Theory 2026
postings.conferenceText: COLT 2026 is the 39th Annual Conference on Learning Theory, a leading venue for theoretical research in machine learning. The conference focuses on mathematically grounded work in learning algorithms, statistical and online learning, optimization, bandits, reinforcement learning theory, and related areas. The 2026 edition is held in San Diego, California and continues COLT's tradition as a core conference for the theory side of modern machine learning. The conference covers learning theory broadly, including sample complexity and generalization, online learning, bandits, reinforcement learning theory, optimization and non-convex learning, probabilistic and information-theoretic analysis, algorithmic fairness and robustness from a theoretical perspective, and formal foundations of modern learning methods.

postings.conferenceName: International Conference on Concurrency Theory 2026
postings.conferenceText: CONCUR 2026 is the International Conference on Concurrency Theory, a major forum for the theory of concurrent, distributed, and reactive systems. Held as part of CONFEST 2026 in Liverpool, the conference welcomes work on the mathematical, algorithmic, logical, and semantic foundations of interacting computation. CONCUR has a long history of linking rigorous theory with models and methods that support the analysis and verification of modern distributed systems. Concurrency theory; models of distributed and reactive systems; process calculi and behavioral equivalences; semantics and logics of concurrency; model checking and verification; synthesis and controller design; probabilistic and timed systems; games, automata and formal languages for concurrent computation; applications to distributed, cyber-physical and communication systems.

postings.conferenceName: International Conference on emerging Networking EXperiments and Technologies 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: International Conference on emerging Networking EXperiments and Technologies
postings.conferenceText: CoNEXT 2026 is the International Conference on emerging Networking EXperiments and Technologies, a major forum for networking research that combines experimental systems work with forward-looking ideas. The conference encourages contributions on new networking mechanisms, architectures, measurements, and applications, with strong emphasis on practical relevance and empirical validation. The 2026 edition in Utrecht continues CoNEXT’s role in showcasing innovative networking technologies and Internet-scale experimentation. Emerging network architectures and protocols; networking systems and experimentation; Internet measurement and analysis; cloud, edge and datacenter networking; wireless and mobile networking; programmable and software-defined networks; network security and resilience; AI/ML for networking; real-world deployments and evaluation of networking technologies.

postings.conferenceName: Conference on Computational Natural Language Learning 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: Conference on Computational Natural Language Learning
postings.conferenceText: CoNLL is a top-tier conference in computational linguistics and NLP with a distinctive emphasis on theoretically, cognitively, and scientifically motivated approaches. Co-located with ACL 2026, the conference brings together work on computational models of language, cognition, interaction, multilinguality, speech, semantics, and interpretation of modern ML models for NLP. The venue is particularly well suited to research that combines linguistic theory, cognitive science, and robust computational methodology. Computational psycholinguistics, cognition and linguistics; usage-based grammars; computational social science and sociolinguistics; interaction and dialogue; language acquisition, learning, emergence, and evolution; multimodality and grounding; typology and multilinguality; speech and phonology; syntax and morphology; lexical, compositional and discourse semantics; theoretical analysis and interpretation of ML models for NLP; resources and tools for scientifically motivated research; language and the brain.

postings.conferenceName: 15th United Kingdom Automatic Control Council International Conference on Control 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 15th United Kingdom Automatic Control Council International Conference on Control
postings.conferenceText: CONTROL 2026 is the 15th United Kingdom Automatic Control Council (UKACC) International Conference on Control, a flagship event for the automatic control community in the United Kingdom and beyond. The official website positions the conference as a major meeting for researchers and practitioners working across control engineering, systems, automation and applications. The 2026 edition will be held in Newcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom, at Newcastle University. The conference emphasizes exchange across theory, computation and real-world systems, and uses an extended-abstract-led submission format for its technical programme. Automatic control theory and applications; systems and control engineering; modelling, identification and estimation; nonlinear and robust control; intelligent and adaptive control; optimization and decision systems; networked and distributed control; robotics and autonomous systems; industrial control and automation; transportation, energy and other applied control domains; broader topics aligned with modern control research and engineering practice.

postings.conferenceName: Conference on Robot Learning 2026
postings.conferenceText: CoRL 2026 is the Conference on Robot Learning, an annual conference at the intersection of robotics and machine learning. The conference is dedicated to methods that enable robots to learn from data, interaction, simulation, and structured priors, as well as to the deployment of learned behavior in real robotic systems. The 2026 edition in Austin continues CoRL’s role as a central venue for modern research on learning-enabled perception, control, planning, and embodied intelligence. Robot learning; reinforcement learning for robotics; imitation and demonstration learning; perception for embodied systems; manipulation and locomotion; planning and control with learned components; sim-to-real transfer; foundation models and large models for robotics; multi-robot learning; safe, robust and deployable learning for real robots.

postings.conferenceName: 32nd International Conference on Principles and Practice of Constraint Programming 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 32nd International Conference on Principles and Practice of Constraint Programming
postings.conferenceText: CP 2026 is the 32nd International Conference on Principles and Practice of Constraint Programming, a core venue for research on constraint reasoning and combinatorial problem solving. The conference brings together work on theoretical foundations, algorithms, modeling, and applications of constraint programming across both academia and practice. As part of FLoC 2026, the Lisbon edition continues the CP series’ focus on advancing expressive modeling and efficient solving technologies. Constraint programming theory and practice; satisfiability and SMT connections; optimization and search; global constraints; modeling languages and formalisms; propagation, learning, and explanation techniques; hybrid methods; applications of constraint reasoning in scheduling, planning, verification, and industrial domains.

postings.conferenceName: Conference on Parsimony and Learning 2026
postings.conferenceText: CPAL is an annual research conference centered on parsimonious and low-dimensional structure in modern learning systems. The conference brings together work on theory, algorithms, applications, hardware, and scientific foundations for learning with parsimony, with strong links to machine learning, signal processing, and optimization. The 2026 edition is the third CPAL conference and is hosted in Tübingen by leading local AI and intelligent systems institutions. Parsimony and low-dimensional structure in machine learning; signal processing; optimization; theories and algorithms for sparse and efficient learning; applications; hardware and systems; scientific foundations for learning with parsimony; proceedings track, spotlight track, tutorials, and rising stars program.

postings.conferenceName: World Congress on Climate-Resilient Agriculture and Food Systems 2027
postings.conferenceText: Conference: World Congress on Climate-Resilient Agriculture and Food Systems (CRAFS 2027) Venue: Village Hotel Changi, Singapore Dates: March 18-20, 2027 Mode: Hybrid (Onsite + Virtual) Branded as the Agriculture Summit 2027, this gathering champions cross-sector dialogue on climate-resilient agriculture, sustainable food systems, agri-tech, and environmental policy - opening doors for academic collaboration, journal publication, and scientific networking across continents. The Agriculture Symposium 2027 welcomes abstracts from agronomists, agri-tech engineers, policymakers, NGO researchers, and food-industry professionals; selected work is presented in oral or poster sessions that prioritise indexing visibility and academic reach. Interdisciplinary by design, the program convenes voices from academia, research institutes, agri-tech industries, NGOs, and ministries of agriculture and environment. Sessions surface advances across precision agriculture, smart farming, climate adaptation, soil and water management, and sustainable food systems - giving attendees a panoramic view of where global agriculture is heading. The hybrid format extends that reach to participants who cannot travel. postings.conferenceName: The 14th International Conference on Computational Visual Media 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: The 14th International Conference on Computational Visual Media
postings.conferenceText: The Computational Visual Media Conference series provides a major international forum for exchanging new research ideas and significant practical results in visual media. CVM emphasizes cross-disciplinary work spanning computer graphics, computer vision, machine learning, image and video processing, visualization, and geometric computing. The 2026 edition in Seoul continues the series’ focus on the classification, composition, retrieval, synthesis, and understanding of visual media, while also highlighting the fast-growing opportunities created by large-scale online visual data. Computer graphics; computer vision; machine learning for visual media; image and video processing; visualization; geometric computing; classification, composition, retrieval, synthesis, and understanding of visual media; cross-disciplinary visual computing research and applications.

postings.conferenceName: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition 2026 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition 2026
postings.conferenceText: CVPR 2026 is the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition, one of the premier international venues for computer vision, image understanding, and pattern recognition. The conference brings together advances in visual perception, learning-based vision, multimodal understanding, and applications that connect vision research to robotics, graphics, and real-world intelligent systems. The 2026 edition is hosted at the Colorado Convention Center in Denver. The conference broadly covers computer vision and pattern recognition, including image and video understanding, object detection and segmentation, 3D vision, multimodal and vision-language learning, generative modeling for vision, visual reasoning, biomedical and scientific imaging, robotics-oriented perception, and related theoretical and application-driven advances.

postings.conferenceName: Chemistry World Congress (CWC 2027)
postings.conferenceText: Chemistry World Congress 2027 The Chemistry World Congress (CWC 2027) will be held from June 21–23, 2027 in Barcelona, Spain and Online under the central theme "Shaping the Future Through Chemical Innovation." As a premier international scientific forum, CWC 2027 brings together leading chemists, researchers, academicians, industrial scientists, and policymakers to discuss breakthrough developments across organic, inorganic, analytical, physical, medicinal, and green chemistry. The conference offers a vibrant platform to exchange state-of-the-art research, foster global cross-disciplinary collaborations, and drive sustainable solutions for global scientific and technological challenges. Chemistry Research Conference 2027 Join international researchers and academic leaders at Chemistry World Congress 2027 in Barcelona to explore cutting-edge advancements in molecular research, synthetic methods, chemical synthesis, and industrial chemistry. CWC 2027 serves as an essential nexus for presenting peer-reviewed research, exploring new chemical methodologies, and bridging the gap between theoretical laboratory findings and practical real-world applications across various scientific sectors. • #ChemistryResearch #ChemicalSciences #MolecularResearch #BarcelonaConference #AcademicResearch #ChemistryCongress #ScientificInnovation

postings.conferenceName: Design, Automation and Test in Europe Conference 2026 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: Design, Automation and Test in Europe Conference 2026
postings.conferenceText: DATE 2026 is the Design, Automation and Test in Europe Conference, the main European event that brings together designers, design automation users, researchers, vendors, and specialists in hardware and software design, test, and manufacturing of electronic circuits and systems. The conference emphasizes both technology and systems, spanning ICs and SoCs, reconfigurable hardware, embedded systems, and embedded software. The 2026 edition, the 29th in the series, is held in Verona, Italy and combines research papers with keynotes, focus sessions, tutorials, workshops, project sessions, and networking-oriented activities. The official call for papers states that DATE addresses all aspects of research into technologies for electronic and systems engineering. It covers design processes, test, and design-automation tools for electronic products from integrated circuits to distributed large-scale systems, including both hardware and embedded software design. Research tracks include Design Methods and Tools (e.g., high-level synthesis, simulation, formal methods, hardware security, NoC, low-power design, reconfigurable systems, physical design, emerging technologies, and design automation for quantum computing); Application Design (e.g., sustainable computing, smart society and digital wellness, secure systems, autonomous systems, applications of emerging technologies, and AI systems); Test and Dependability; and Embedded Systems Design.

postings.conferenceName: Data Compression Conference 2026
postings.conferenceText: The Data Compression Conference is an international forum for current work on data compression and related applications. DCC brings together theoretical and experimental research on compression methods, coding, compressed data structures, and compression-driven applications. The conference covers both foundational advances and application-oriented work in domains such as images, video, networking, storage, bioinformatics, mobile computing, and information retrieval. Compression of text, images, video and other data types; networking, communications, and storage compression; bioinformatics applications; mobile computing and information retrieval applications; compressed data structures; quantization and vector quantization; joint source-channel coding; compression-related standards; perceptual coding and inpainting-based compression.

postings.conferenceName: Dental 2027
postings.conferenceSeries: 12th Edition of International Conference on Dental Innovations and Technologies
postings.conferenceText: No summary yet. The 12th Edition of International Conference on Dental Innovations and Technologies (Dental 2027) will take place from March 15-17, 2027, at Village Hotel Changi, Singapore, with a hybrid format that also enables virtual participation from anywhere in the world. Hosted by Magnus Group LLC, the Dental Research Conference 2027 will bring together dentists, oral surgeons, dental hygienists, oral health practitioners, researchers, academicians, and students for three days of scientific discussions, peer-reviewed presentations, and interdisciplinary collaboration across dentistry and oral healthcare. The scientific program will cover a broad range of topics, including general dentistry, endodontics, orthodontics, periodontology, prosthodontics and implantology, oral and maxillofacial surgery, oral pathology and medicine, pain management and anesthesia, pediatric and geriatric dentistry, aesthetic and cosmetic dentistry, preventive and community dentistry, oral cancer and oncology, and oral epidemiology and public health. Researchers, practitioners, and academics are encouraged to submit original research findings, case studies, and review presentations for oral and poster sessions. Attendees may register through the official International Dental Conference 2027 platform to participate either in person in Singapore or virtually, ensuring broad international engagement and accessibility.

postings.conferenceName: 29th Euromicro Conference Series on Digital System Design (DSD) 2026 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 29th Euromicro Conference Series on Digital System Design (DSD) 2026
postings.conferenceText: DSD 2026 is the 29th Euromicro Conference Series on Digital System Design, a long-running international venue focused on digital and mixed hardware/software system development. The official call describes DSD as addressing the full design process, from specification and design methodology to processor architectures, digital circuits, and VLSI implementations. It aims to bring together researchers and engineers from academia and industry working on advanced research, development, and applications in embedded, pervasive, and high-performance systems. The 2026 edition will be held at the AGH University of Kraków, Poland. Beyond the core conference series identity under Euromicro, the conference emphasizes current and future challenges in cyber-physical and embedded systems, design automation, modern implementation technologies, and application-driven innovation across hardware and systems design. Embedded, pervasive and high-performance digital and mixed HW/SW system development; system and processor architectures for embedded and high-performance HW/SW systems; design methodology and design automation for all design levels of embedded, high-performance and cyber-physical systems; modern implementation technologies from full-custom circuits in nanometer technology nodes to FPGAs and MPSoC infrastructures. Main topics listed on the official CFP page include: artificial intelligence from edge to cloud—architectures, methods, tools and applications; design and synthesis of systems, hardware and embedded software—specification, modelling, analysis, validation and testing; design automation at system, processor, register-transfer, logic and physical levels; formal methods in system and hardware design; IoT, cyber-physical, embedded systems and applications; systems-on-a-chip, networks-on-a-chip and systems-in-a-package; high-performance, energy-efficient multi-core and many-core heterogeneous processor architectures; autonomous, adaptable and reconfigurable systems and architectures; security, safety, reliability and multi-objective optimization of embedded and cyber-physical systems; future trends, new applications and new technologies.

postings.conferenceName: International Conference on Evaluation and Assessment in Software Engineering 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: International Conference on Evaluation and Assessment in Software Engineering
postings.conferenceText: EASE is a well-known conference focused on evaluation and assessment in software engineering. The 2026 edition in Glasgow includes a broad set of research and community tracks, reflecting the conference’s role as a home for empirical, reproducible, and evidence-driven software engineering. Alongside research papers, the program covers emerging results, industry papers, posters and vision papers, journal-first presentations, doctoral work, AI/data themes, and reproducibility and negative results. Evaluation and assessment in software engineering; research papers; short papers and emerging results; industry papers; posters and vision; journal-first papers; doctoral symposium; AI models and data; reproducibility and negative results; workshops and tutorials.

postings.conferenceName: 10th EuChemS Chemistry Congress 2026
postings.conferenceText: The 10th EuChemS Chemistry Congress (ECC10) is a major European chemistry congress organized under EuChemS and hosted in Antwerp, Belgium. The official conference information presents the event as a broad scientific gathering spanning multiple branches of chemistry and closely related interdisciplinary areas, including innovative materials and sustainability-focused research. The congress is designed to connect researchers from academia, industry, and public institutions through lectures, contributed presentations, and theme-based sessions. Although not limited to materials science, the official themes include strong coverage of innovative materials, molecular design, energy, sustainability, analytical and physical chemistry, and computational approaches relevant to materials chemistry and advanced chemical sciences. Congress themes include catalyzing new chemistry solutions; chemistry meeting biology and food science; computational chemistry and AI; energy, environment and sustainability; innovative materials; molecular design and reactivity; analytical and physical chemistry; and responsible chemistry for society. These themes encompass advanced materials chemistry, energy-related systems, sustainability challenges, and interdisciplinary chemical sciences.

postings.conferenceName: 22nd Emirates Critical Care Conference 2026
postings.conferenceText: The 22nd Emirates Critical Care Conference (ECCC 2026) is a major regional meeting in critical and intensive care medicine to be held in Dubai. According to the official site, the 2026 edition runs under the theme “From Evidence to Excellence: The Future of Critical Care” and brings together a broad scientific program of keynote sessions, interactive discussions, workshops, and courses designed to strengthen clinical expertise and support best practice in acute and critical care. The conference presents itself as a long-running series with over two decades of history and strong collaboration with international professional bodies in intensive and critical care. The 2026 event is scheduled at the InterContinental Event Centre in Dubai Festival City and includes conference sessions, workshops, courses, and poster abstract presentations. The official material emphasizes international speakers, multidisciplinary participation, and the conference’s role as a cornerstone event for the critical care community in the region. Critical care medicine; intensive care; evidence-based critical care practice; future of critical care; keynote sessions; interactive scientific discussions; poster abstracts; workshops and courses. The official site explicitly lists parallel or collaborating activities with the World Federation of Intensive and Critical Care (WFICC), the World Federation of Critical Care Nurses (WFCCN), and the Emirates Nursing Association Critical Care Chapter. Workshops and courses highlighted on the site include ECHO Course, Ultrasound Course, ECMO Workshop, and BASIC for nurses. The abstract submission page states that, for 2026, poster abstracts are accepted and reviewed by the scientific committee, with abstracts expected to include background, aim, methods, results/findings, and conclusions.

postings.conferenceName: 19th European Conference on Computer Vision 2026
postings.conferenceText: ECCV 2026 is the 19th European Conference on Computer Vision, a premier research conference in computer vision and machine learning managed by the European Computer Vision Association. The conference is known as one of the most important global venues for new work in visual understanding, learning, recognition, and vision-enabled applications. The 2026 edition is held in Malmö, Sweden. The conference focuses on computer vision and related machine learning topics, including image and video understanding, recognition, 3D vision, visual reasoning, vision-language methods, generative approaches for vision, and application areas across science, industry, and intelligent systems.

postings.conferenceName: The 48th European Conference on Information Retrieval 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: The 48th European Conference on Information Retrieval

postings.conferenceName: 24th IEEE International Conference on Software Architecture 2027
postings.conferenceSeries: 24th IEEE International Conference on Software Architecture
postings.conferenceText: ICSA 2027 is the 24th IEEE International Conference on Software Architecture and is presented on the official site as a premier forum for software architecture research and practice. Since 1998, the conference has brought together researchers, practitioners, and educators to exchange ideas, share experience, and shape the future of software architecture. A defining characteristic highlighted by the organizers is its working-conference tradition, in which interactive sessions connect researchers and practitioners around real architectural challenges and future agendas for the field. The 2027 edition will be hosted by CSIRO in Sydney, Australia, and continues this tradition in a context where AI-assisted development and rapidly changing implementation techniques are reshaping software engineering. The official theme for the research track is “The Enduring Role of Software Architecture in an Evolving Landscape,” with particular interest in how AI influences architectural design, decision making, and system evolution. Requirements & Architecture: stakeholder management and collaboration with other domains; linking architecture to requirements and/or implementation; linking architecture to spec-driven development; methods to address the intertwining of specification and design; sustainability, ethics, business, financial, and managerial aspects of software architecture. Architecture Design: model-driven architecture; component-based software engineering; architecture frameworks and architecture description languages; reusable architectural solutions and architecture knowledge management. Cloud-native Computing & Architecture: microservices and containerization; serverless platforms and novel forms of virtualization; event-driven architectures; observability and distributed tracing. Architecture Evaluation: evaluating quality aspects such as security, performance, reliability and evolvability; architecture conformance checking; real-time architecture observability and adaptation beyond static compliance; lightweight evaluation methods; new and emerging quality attributes, tactics and evaluation methods including energy consumption and environmental impact. Architecture & its lifecycle: automatic extraction and generation of software architecture descriptions; architecture in CI/CD and DevOps; refactoring and evolving architecture design decisions; agile and continuous architecting. Architecture & Architects: roles and responsibilities for software architects; training, mentoring, education and certification; equality, diversity and inclusion; state of the art and state of practice; architecture copilot for supporting architects. Architecture for specific systems: edge, fog and IoT systems; AI/ML/LLM-based systems; blockchains; cyber-physical systems; self-adaptive and autonomous systems; agent and multi-agent systems including agentic AI. Architecture & Generative AI: design assistance; comparing technologies and trade-offs; code generation from architecture designs; architectural design supported by generative AI; architecture principles for AI systems.

Information Integration: multimodal information fusion; information science and theory; AI and security; symbolic AI; hallucination detection and mitigation in AI; novel AI applications in computer vision, computer forensics, security, fake/forgery detection, robotics, recommender systems, and biomedical areas. Information Reuse: data lifecycle reuse; afterlives of data in AI/ML models; preventing model collapse via improved data lineage; knowledge graphs; ontologies, variable alignment, and contextual metadata; cross-domain and multilingual metadata systems; reuse in LLM and AI training data; interoperability and cross-disciplinary reuse; linking datasets from different domains or formats; tools for data transformation and harmonization. Reusable Systems: acceleration of AI system reuse and reuse efficiency; brain-computer interface applications and algorithms; reusable AI for edge and IoT; reusable AI in industry applications; software and systems reuse and reusability; software sustainability and reuse economics; software maintenance and life-cycle management; software reliability, robustness, and dependability; system applications in autonomous vehicles, business, education, engineering, healthcare, IoT, multimedia, NLP, robotics, science, security, social networking, space, and vision.

postings.conferenceName: ACM Internet Measurement Conference 2026 2026
postings.conferenceText: IMC 2026 is the ACM Internet Measurement Conference, a leading venue for the collection, analysis, and interpretation of data about the Internet and operational networks. postings.conferenceSeries: International Symposium on Intelligent Technologies for Smart Agriculture
postings.conferenceText: The 2nd International Symposium on Intelligent Technologies for Smart Agriculture (ITSA 2026) will be held in Bangkok, Thailand from August 21-23, 2026. Following the success of the inaugural event held in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia in September 2025, this conference aims to provide an open and innovative communication platform for global experts, scholars, researchers, and industry practitioners to explore cutting-edge developments, challenges, and opportunities in smart agriculture and intelligent technology, fostering digital transformation and sustainable agricultural development. The conference will cover multiple research hotspots, from agricultural intelligent perception and decision support, to precision animal farming and smart planting, to big data-driven supply chain management and climate adaptive agricultural solutions. ITSA 2026 warmly welcomes experts, researchers, and practitioners from across the globe to contribute to this vital dialogue, fostering innovations that shape a sustainable and technology-driven future for agriculture. The accepted and registered papers will be featured in ITSA 2026 Conference Proceedings. The proceedings will be published under Springer's esteemed "Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems" series. Furthermore, all contributions will be submitted for inclusion in prominent databases such as EI Compendex and Scopus. postings.conferenceSeries: ACM Conference on Intelligent User Interfaces
postings.conferenceText: IUI 2026 is the ACM Conference on Intelligent User Interfaces, a premier venue at the intersection of artificial intelligence and human-computer interaction. The conference highlights research on how intelligent computational techniques can augment, adapt, and transform interactive systems and user experiences. The 2026 edition in Cyprus continues IUI’s role as a core forum for AI-enabled interface design, evaluation, and deployment. Intelligent user interfaces; AI in human-computer interaction; adaptive and personalized interfaces; interactive machine learning; multimodal and conversational interaction; user modeling; evaluation of intelligent interactive systems; applications that combine AI techniques with interface innovation.

postings.conferenceName: IEEE JointCloud Computing Conference 2026 2026
postings.conferenceText: JCC 2026 is the IEEE JointCloud Computing Conference, a forum for researchers and practitioners to exchange innovative ideas on JointCloud systems and next-generation cloud computing. The 2026 edition is organized as a hybrid event in Tokyo and highlights the convergence of distributed cloud infrastructure with advanced AI models, including LLMs and generative AI. The conference is intended to connect systems research, platform design, and emerging application demands in collaborative cloud environments. JointCloud architectures and platforms; distributed and hybrid cloud systems; cloud management and orchestration; AI infrastructure, LLMs and generative AI on cloud platforms; performance, scalability and reliability; data management and storage for cloud systems; security and privacy; edge-cloud collaboration; cloud-native applications and services.

postings.conferenceSeries: 30th International Conference on Knowledge-Based and Intelligent Information & Engineering Systems
postings.conferenceText: KES 2026, the 30th International Conference on Knowledge-Based and Intelligent Information & Engineering Systems, is a long-running international conference organized by KES International. The official conference materials describe it as a forum covering a broad spectrum of intelligent systems research, with emphasis on knowledge-based methods, intelligent information processing and engineering applications. The 2026 edition is scheduled to take place in Dublin, Ireland. The conference typically attracts work spanning theory, computational methods and practical systems in intelligent engineering, reflecting its broad and interdisciplinary orientation. Knowledge-based systems; intelligent information systems; intelligent data processing; symbolic representations, rules and logic; ontologies and semantic systems; hybrid intelligent systems; machine learning and computational intelligence; decision support; intelligent agents; engineering applications of intelligent systems; data-driven and knowledge-driven methods; information engineering and related intelligent technologies.

postings.conferenceSeries: 23rd International Conference on Principles of Knowledge Representation and Reasoning
postings.conferenceText: KR 2026 is the 23rd International Conference on Principles of Knowledge Representation and Reasoning, the leading forum for research in knowledge representation and reasoning within artificial intelligence. The conference covers formal and computational approaches to representing knowledge, drawing inferences, and connecting symbolic reasoning with broader AI and systems areas. The 2026 edition is held in Lisbon, Portugal as part of FLoC 2026, with workshops around the main dates. The conference welcomes work on the principles of knowledge representation and reasoning and highlights links with planning, robotics, natural language processing, machine learning, data management, the semantic web, verification, and software engineering. The site also lists special tracks such as KR Meets ML and Explanation, and KR in the Wild.

postings.conferenceSeries: 19th International Conference on Knowledge Science, Engineering and Management

The conference focuses on research and practice in knowledge representation, engineering, management, and intelligent information processing, and serves as an international forum for scholars and practitioners in related areas. The 2026 edition will be held in Beijing and continues the KSEM series as a venue for interdisciplinary work connecting AI, knowledge technologies, and management applications. Knowledge science and engineering; knowledge representation and reasoning; knowledge management; intelligent information processing; AI-enabled knowledge services; data, semantics, and decision support; applications of knowledge technologies in science, engineering, and management.

postings.conferenceName: 51st IEEE Conference on Local Computer Networks 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 51st IEEE Conference on Local Computer Networks
postings.conferenceText: LCN 2026 is the 51st IEEE Conference on Local Computer Networks, a long-running international conference on the theory and practice of computer networking. The conference covers networking architectures, protocols, measurements, and applications, with particular attention to modern wired, wireless, and edge-connected environments. Its long history and broad technical scope make it an established forum for both foundational and systems-oriented networking research. Local and wireless networks; network protocols and architectures; network performance and measurement; IoT and sensor networking; edge and cloud-connected networking; network security and privacy; software-defined networking and network management; dependable and resilient communication systems; emerging applications and services over computer networks.

LICS connects logic with programming languages, verification, semantics, complexity, and other core areas of theoretical computer science. postings.conferenceName: International Conference on Medical Imaging and Computer-Aided Diagnosis 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: International Conference on Medical Imaging and Computer-Aided Diagnosis
postings.conferenceText: Introduction We are pleased to welcome you to the 7th International Conference on Medical Imaging and Computer-Aided Diagnosis (MICAD 2026), which will take place in Edinburgh, United Kingdom, from October 22 to 24, 2026. Over the past six editions—Oxford (2020), Birmingham (2021), Leicester (2022), Cambridge (2023), Manchester (2024), and London (2025)—MICAD has established itself as a leading international forum in Europe, bringing together researchers, clinicians, engineers, and industry professionals from around the world to exchange ideas and advance the field of medical imaging and computer-aided diagnosis. MICAD 2026 aims to foster high-level academic exchange on multimodal medical image intelligent analysis, medical imaging foundation models, trustworthy and explainable artificial intelligence, intelligent computer-aided diagnosis systems, and the deep integration of medical imaging with clinical decision-making and precision medicine. The conference will feature a comprehensive and dynamic technical program, including Keynote and invited speeches delivered by internationally recognized experts. In addition, Oral and Poster Sessions will present cutting-edge research findings, methodological innovations, and clinically relevant applications. To recognize excellence, Best Paper Awards will be presented, and participants will benefit from valuable networking opportunities with leading academics, clinicians, and industry innovators. Publication All submitted papers will undergo a rigorous peer-review process facilitated by our conference committees. Accepted and presented papers will be featured in the MICAD 2026 Conference Proceedings which will be published with Springer in their "Lecture Notes in Electrical Engineering (LNEE)" (ISSN: 1876-1100). Furthermore, the proceedings will be submitted for indexing to prominent databases including EI-Compendex, SCOPUS, and Springerlink. The 2026 event is held in Abu Dhabi, with satellite events surrounding the main conference program. The conference centers on medical image computing and computer-assisted intervention, including image segmentation and registration, computer-aided diagnosis, surgical data science, image-guided therapy, learning for medical imaging, multimodal and longitudinal analysis, intervention planning, navigation and robotics, and translational clinical applications.

postings.conferenceName: Ninth Annual Conference on Machine Learning and Systems 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: Ninth Annual Conference on Machine Learning and Systems
postings.conferenceText: MLSys 2026 is the ninth annual Conference on Machine Learning and Systems, a major venue at the intersection of machine learning and systems. The conference highlights research that advances the infrastructure, algorithms, and tools needed to train, deploy, optimize, and evaluate modern ML workloads. The 2026 edition in Bellevue continues MLSys’s strong emphasis on bridging ML methods with systems design, hardware, software, and operational concerns. Efficient training and inference for machine learning; LLM training, fine-tuning, and inference; compound AI systems; distributed and federated learning; privacy and security in ML systems; scheduling and resource management; testing and debugging of ML systems; fairness and explainability with systems implications; data preparation pipelines; programming models, compilers, visualization tools, specialized hardware, and benchmarks for ML systems.

postings.conferenceName: 33rd International Conference on Multimedia Modeling 2027
postings.conferenceText: MMM 2027 is the 33rd International Conference on Multimedia Modeling, a well-established international forum for research on the modeling, analysis, retrieval, generation, and applications of multimedia data. The conference brings together work from multimedia systems, content understanding, user interaction, and emerging multimedia applications, and has built a long series history across Asia and beyond. The conference addresses multimedia modeling and related areas, including multimedia analysis and retrieval, video and image understanding, multimodal learning, content generation, user interaction, systems for multimedia applications, demonstrations, special sessions, workshop activities, and forward-looking ideas in new multimedia directions.

postings.conferenceName: The 32nd Annual International Conference on Mobile Computing and Networking 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: The 32nd Annual International Conference on Mobile Computing and Networking
postings.conferenceText: MobiCom 2026 is the 32nd Annual International Conference on Mobile Computing and Networking, a highly selective premier international forum dedicated to challenges in mobile computing and wireless and mobile networking. Sponsored by ACM SIGMOBILE, the conference covers networks, systems, algorithms, and applications that support mobile devices and wireless networks. The 2026 edition takes place in Austin, Texas and also includes workshops, research demonstrations, and a poster session with the ACM Student Research Competition. The conference addresses mobile computing and networking broadly, including mobile and wireless systems, networking protocols, algorithms for mobility and wireless environments, platforms and applications for mobile systems, experimental and deployment-driven studies, and supporting demonstrations, workshops, and poster activities.

Mobile ad hoc and wireless networks; protocol design and analysis; algorithmic foundations of mobile computing; sensing and IoT systems; edge and pervasive computing; network optimization and resource management; localization, mobility modeling and tracking; security, privacy and trust in mobile systems; experimental evaluation and systems for mobile and wireless computing.

postings.conferenceSeries: The 24th ACM International Conference on Mobile Systems, Applications, and Services

postings.conferenceName: 2026 MRS Fall Meeting & Exhibit 2026
postings.conferenceText: The 2026 MRS Fall Meeting & Exhibit is a flagship international gathering organized by the Materials Research Society and held in Boston, Massachusetts. The meeting serves as a major forum for interdisciplinary materials research, bringing together scientists and engineers working on fundamental materials science, device-relevant materials, processing, characterization, and emerging application domains. The 2026 program highlights broad technical clusters including broader impacts and policy, characterization, electronics/optics/photonics, energy and sustainability, AI for materials, nanomaterials, quantum materials, soft materials and biomaterials, and structural and functional materials. Through symposia, abstract presentations, and exhibition activities, the meeting supports cross-disciplinary exchange across the global materials community. Call for abstracts areas include broader impact and community-oriented materials research; advanced characterization and microscopy; electronics, optics and photonics materials; energy generation, storage and sustainability; AI for materials discovery and data-driven materials science; nanomaterials and nanostructures; quantum materials and related phenomena; soft materials, bio materials and biomaterials; structural materials; functional materials; and numerous focused symposia within each cluster.

postings.conferenceName: 2026 MRS Spring Meeting & Exhibit 2026
postings.conferenceText: The 2026 MRS Spring Meeting & Exhibit is one of the flagship annual meetings of the Materials Research Society. Held in Honolulu, Hawai‘i, the meeting brings together researchers from academia, industry, and government to discuss advances across the full spectrum of materials research. The program is organized around broad topical clusters and emphasizes interdisciplinary exchange, emerging materials platforms, characterization methods, energy and sustainability applications, nanomaterials, electronics and photonics, soft and bio materials, quantum materials, and AI-enabled materials research. In addition to technical symposia, the event includes tutorials, networking, and exhibit activities that support the broader materials community. Broad topical clusters and symposium sessions spanning materials discovery and design; characterization and in situ or operando analysis; electronic, optical and photonic materials; energy storage and conversion materials; sustainability-related materials research; nanomaterials and nanoscale systems; quantum and electronic materials; structural and functional materials; soft materials and biomaterials; computational and data-driven materials research; AI for materials science; interdisciplinary materials applications and enabling technologies.

It aims to bring together contributions from academia and industry and emphasizes broad discussion across strength of materials, mechanical analysis, and application-oriented materials research. Topics of interest include strength of materials; mechanical behavior and constitutive analysis; fatigue and fracture; stress and strain analysis; solid mechanics; structural reliability; computational mechanics; nano-materials and biomaterials; materials forming and processing; experimental mechanics; applied mechanics methods; and engineering applications connected to material performance and strength.

Mining software repositories; software analytics; source control, issue tracker, review, and CI data; machine learning and data science for software engineering; empirical studies of development processes; software quality, productivity, and evolution based on software engineering data.

postings.conferenceText: NSPW 2026 is the New Security Paradigms Workshop, a distinctive venue devoted to original, often unconventional thinking about computer security. Unlike highly compressed conference formats, NSPW is known for in-depth discussion of accepted papers and for encouraging new perspectives on the conceptual foundations of security and privacy. The 2026 workshop in Victoria continues that tradition by bringing together a small, highly interactive community focused on rethinking established assumptions and exploring emerging paradigms. New paradigms in security and privacy; conceptual foundations of secure systems; socio-technical security; human-centered and policy-aware security; security economics and incentives; formal and philosophical perspectives on security; trustworthy computing models; provocative or foundational ideas that challenge conventional approaches.

postings.conferenceName: 7th Edition of Singapore Nursing Research Conference (Nursing 2027) 2027
postings.conferenceSeries: 7th Edition of Singapore Nursing Research Conference (Nursing 2027)
postings.conferenceText: Singapore and Online, March 15-17, 2027 - the 7th Edition of Singapore Nursing Research Conference runs as a hybrid forum across evidence-based practice, mental health nursing, critical care, oncology nursing, and nursing leadership. Hosted in Singapore in hybrid mode (in-person at Village Hotel Changi), the 7th Edition of Singapore Nursing Research Conference (Nursing 2027) runs from March 15-17, 2027. As a CPD-accredited event for the global nursing science and clinical practice community, the three-day programme combines technical updates, practical demonstrations, and case-based discussions that help researchers and practitioners refresh their working knowledge of nursing. Programmatic coverage at this Nursing Care Conference 2027 spans nursing education, evidence-based practice, clinical nursing, pediatric nursing, psychiatric and mental health nursing, midwifery and women's health, oncology nursing, anesthesia and peri-anesthesia care, emergency and ambulatory care, intensive and critical care, occupational health, public health nursing, and nursing leadership and professional development. postings.conferenceName: IEEE Pacific Visualization Conference 2026
postings.conferenceText: PacificVis is a long-running IEEE conference on visualization research and technologies, particularly in the Asia-Pacific region. The Sydney meeting continues this trajectory with conference papers, TVCG journal papers, short papers, posters, workshops, and visual storytelling activities, providing a broad platform for methodological and applied visualization research. Visualization research and technologies; common call for papers; TVCG journal papers; conference papers; short papers (VisNotes); posters; visual data storytelling; workshops; paper topics and submission guidelines for the visualization community.

postings.conferenceName: The 30th Pacific-Asia Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: The 30th Pacific-Asia Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining
postings.conferenceText: PAKDD is a prestigious and highly selective conference series on knowledge discovery and data mining. The 2026 edition, the 30th in the series, is held in Hong Kong and provides an international peer-reviewed forum for researchers and industry practitioners to share new ideas, original research results, and practical development experience. The conference scope spans the full KDD pipeline, from data science and machine learning foundations to knowledge engineering, visualization, decision support, and emerging application domains. Knowledge discovery and data mining; data science; data warehousing; machine learning; artificial intelligence; databases; statistics; knowledge engineering; visualization; decision-making systems; emerging applications; tutorials, workshops, keynote and invited talks.

postings.conferenceName: The 26th International Conference on Parallel and Distributed Computing, Applications and Technologies 2025
postings.conferenceSeries: The 26th International Conference on Parallel and Distributed Computing, Applications and Technologies
postings.conferenceText: PDCAT is an international conference series on parallel and distributed computing, applications, and technologies. The 2025 edition in Gold Coast continues more than two decades of meetings across the Asia-Oceania region and provides a forum for scientists, engineers, and practitioners to exchange advances, applications, and emerging ideas in scalable computing. The conference is held in person with support for live online participation and publishes accepted presented papers in Springer LNCS. Parallel and distributed computing; scalable systems and applications; research results, innovative ideas, and applications in parallel and distributed technologies across diverse domains; hybrid participation and LNCS proceedings.

postings.conferenceName: The 24th International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Communications 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: The 24th International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Communications
postings.conferenceText: PerCom is the premier annual scholarly venue in pervasive computing and communications. As a flagship IEEE event, PerCom brings together foundational research and system-oriented work in technologies that now underpin many commercial and real-world pervasive systems. Pervasive computing and communications; mobile systems; wireless networking; distributed computing; sensor systems; ambient intelligence; smart devices; research papers, demos, artifacts, workshops, and PhD forum contributions.

postings.conferenceName: 26th Privacy Enhancing Technologies Symposium 2026
postings.conferenceText: The 26th Privacy Enhancing Technologies Symposium (PETS 2026) is a leading forum for research on privacy technologies, policy, and practice. The symposium brings together researchers and practitioners working on the design, analysis, implementation, deployment, and evaluation of privacy-enhancing technologies, with scope spanning computer science, communications, social sciences, economics, and policy. PETS 2026 will be held in Calgary as a hybrid event and continues the long-running PETS series focused on both foundational advances and real-world privacy challenges. Privacy-enhancing technologies; anonymity and pseudonymity systems; censorship circumvention; traffic analysis defenses; communication systems and metadata privacy; privacy in machine learning and AI; genomic and health privacy; location and Web privacy; privacy measurements and attacks; transparency and accountability; usable privacy and human factors; applied cryptography for privacy; differential privacy; privacy policy, economics, and deployment issues.

postings.conferenceName: International Conference on Practice and Theory of Public-Key Cryptography 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: International Conference on Practice and Theory of Public-Key Cryptography
postings.conferenceText: PKC 2026 is the IACR conference dedicated to public-key cryptography and related areas. The 2026 edition will take place in West Palm Beach and continues the well-established PKC tradition within the international cryptography community. Public-key encryption; digital signatures; key exchange and authenticated key establishment; zero-knowledge and succinct proofs; multi-party and threshold cryptography; post-quantum public-key cryptography; lattice-, code-, and number-theoretic cryptography; cryptographic protocols and applications; foundations and security models for public-key systems.

postings.conferenceName: 47th ACM SIGPLAN Conference on Programming Language Design and Implementation 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 47th ACM SIGPLAN Conference on Programming Language Design and Implementation
postings.conferenceText: PLDI 2026 is the 47th ACM SIGPLAN Conference on Programming Language Design and Implementation. The conference is a premier forum for research at the intersection of programming languages and systems, covering language design, compiler and runtime implementation, program analysis, and applications of language technology. The 2026 edition in Boulder continues PLDI’s role as a flagship venue for work that advances the theory and practice of programming systems. Programming language design and implementation; compilers and runtime systems; program analysis and optimization; type systems and semantics; verification and correctness; language support for performance, reliability, and security; practical and theoretical advances in programming systems.

postings.conferenceName: 54th ACM SIGPLAN Symposium on Principles of Programming Languages 2027
postings.conferenceSeries: 54th ACM SIGPLAN Symposium on Principles of Programming Languages
postings.conferenceText: POPL 2027 is the 54th ACM SIGPLAN Symposium on Principles of Programming Languages, one of the flagship conferences in programming languages and formal reasoning about software. The symposium brings together work on language design, type systems, semantics, verification, compilation, and mathematically grounded approaches to programming. The 2027 edition is held in Mexico City as part of the long-running POPL series. The conference focuses on foundational and principled work in programming languages, including semantics, type systems, program verification, logic and theorem proving, compilation, synthesis, language design, mechanized metatheory, program analysis, concurrency, probabilistic and differentiable programming, and rigorous reasoning about real-world software systems.

postings.conferenceName: 19th International Conference on Parallel Problem Solving from Nature 2026

Evolutionary computation; natural computing; iterative optimization heuristics; search heuristics and machine learning connections; theory and empirical studies of optimization; workshop and tutorial topics across evolutionary algorithms, landscape analysis, constrained and multi-objective optimization, automated algorithm design, and related AI methods.

postings.conferenceName: Pacific Rim International Conference on Artificial Intelligence 2026

postings.conferenceName: 29th International Symposium on Research in Attacks, Intrusions and Defenses 2026

Requirements elicitation and discovery; requirements modeling, specification and analysis; validation and verification of requirements; requirements traceability and evolution; human and organizational aspects of requirements engineering; requirements for AI-based, adaptive and autonomous systems; empirical studies, tools and industrial practice; education, datasets and reproducibility in RE.
