postings.conferenceName: Symposium on Geometry Processing 2026 2026
postings.conferenceText: SGP 2026 is the Symposium on Geometry Processing 2026, a leading venue for new research on the computational treatment of geometric data. The symposium brings together work on the mathematical, algorithmic, and practical foundations of geometry processing, linking computer graphics, geometric modeling, vision, fabrication, and related areas. The 2026 edition in Bern continues the series’ role as a core meeting point for geometry-focused research and applications. Geometry processing; geometric modeling and shape analysis; meshes, point clouds and implicit representations; parameterization and remeshing; deformation, editing and simulation of geometry; geometric deep learning; reconstruction and acquisition; geometry for fabrication and digital manufacturing; geometry in graphics, vision and scientific computing.

postings.conferenceName: ACM SIGCOMM 2026 2026
postings.conferenceText: ACM SIGCOMM 2026 is the flagship annual conference of ACM SIGCOMM and one of the most important venues in data communication and networking. The conference seeks significant research contributions and significant deployment experiences in communication networks and networked systems, and the 2026 edition is held at the Colorado Convention Center in Denver, Colorado. The conference accepts both research and experience papers and continues SIGCOMM's role as a premier forum for networking research. According to the official call for papers, SIGCOMM takes a broad view of networking, including all types of computer networks (mobile, wide-area, datacenter, embedded, home, and enterprise), all wired and wireless technologies (optics, radio, acoustic, visible-light communication), and all aspects of networked systems such as architecture, packet- and circuit-switched hardware and software, virtualization, mobility, resource management, performance, energy and environmental impact, topology, robustness, security, diagnosis, verification, privacy, economics, evolution, and interactions with applications. It also welcomes all parts of the network lifecycle and all approaches including theory, analysis, experimentation, and AI/machine learning for networking.

postings.conferenceName: SIGGRAPH 2026: The 53rd International Conference & Exhibition on Computer Graphics & Interactive Techniques 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: SIGGRAPH 2026: The 53rd International Conference & Exhibition on Computer Graphics & Interactive Techniques
postings.conferenceText: SIGGRAPH 2026 is the 53rd International Conference and Exhibition on Computer Graphics and Interactive Techniques, the premier global event for computer graphics, interactive techniques, and adjacent creative and technical fields. The conference and exhibition bring together researchers, artists, developers, designers, and production professionals working across graphics, animation, games, immersive media, and new digital experiences. The 2026 event takes place in Los Angeles, California. The official site organizes the conference around broad areas such as Production and Animation, Research and Education, Arts and Design, Gaming and Interactive, and New Technologies. Submission-related content also references multiple contribution formats and tracks, including posters, real-time presentations, frontiers content, student research, and other graphics and interactive-technique activities.

postings.conferenceName: ACM SIGMETRICS 2026 2026
postings.conferenceText: SIGMETRICS 2026 is the flagship conference of the ACM special interest group for the computer systems performance evaluation community. The conference brings together researchers interested in modeling, measurement, analysis, and evaluation of computer systems and networks. The 2026 edition will be held at the University of Michigan in Ann Arbor and continues SIGMETRICS’s role as a central venue for rigorous systems performance research. Computer systems performance evaluation; modeling and measurement; analytical and empirical evaluation of systems and networks; methodologies and tools for understanding performance, scalability, and efficiency of modern computing systems.

postings.conferenceName: ACM SIGMOD/PODS International Conference on Management of Data 2027
postings.conferenceSeries: ACM SIGMOD/PODS International Conference on Management of Data
postings.conferenceText: SIGMOD 2027 is the ACM SIGMOD/PODS International Conference on Management of Data, one of the flagship conferences in data management. The conference brings together the database systems, data analytics, and theory communities and covers both foundational advances and systems innovations. The 2027 edition in Huntington Beach continues the series’ central role in presenting new ideas in data management architectures, algorithms, and applications at scale. Database systems and architectures; query processing and optimization; transaction processing and concurrency control; data integration and data cleaning; graph, stream and spatial data management; large-scale analytics; cloud and distributed data systems; ML/AI for data management and data management for AI workloads; data privacy, security and responsible data systems.

postings.conferenceName: 34th ACM SIGSPATIAL International Conference on Advances in Geographic Information Systems 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 34th ACM SIGSPATIAL International Conference on Advances in Geographic Information Systems
postings.conferenceText: ACM SIGSPATIAL 2026 is the 34th ACM SIGSPATIAL International Conference on Advances in Geographic Information Systems. The conference is a major venue for geographic information science, spatial data management, and geo-enabled applications, bringing together database, systems, analytics, and geospatial communities. The 2026 edition in Riverside continues the conference’s focus on theory, algorithms, systems, and applications involving spatial, spatio-temporal, and mobility data. Geographic information systems; spatial and spatio-temporal data management; geospatial analytics and mining; mobility data and trajectory analysis; location-based services; maps, spatial indexing and query processing; geospatial machine learning; remote sensing and urban analytics; privacy, ethics and fairness for geospatial data systems.

postings.conferenceName: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics
postings.conferenceText: IEEE SMC 2026 is the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics, the flagship annual meeting of the IEEE SMC Society. The conference provides a broad interdisciplinary platform spanning systems science and engineering, human-machine systems, and cybernetics. The 2026 edition in Bellevue highlights both foundational methods and application-driven work in intelligent systems, human-centered technologies, robotics, autonomy, and secure cyber-physical environments, with in-person participation strongly encouraged while also accommodating online presentation where necessary. Systems science and engineering; human-machine interaction; cybernetics and intelligent systems; artificial intelligence and machine learning; robotics and autonomous systems; cyber-physical systems; decision and control systems; computational intelligence; smart infrastructure and transportation; healthcare and assistive systems; cybersecurity and resilient systems.

postings.conferenceName: Shape Modeling International 2025
postings.conferenceText: SMI is an international forum for new mathematical theories and computational techniques for modeling, simulating, and processing digital representations of shapes and their properties. The 2025 event is co-located with SPM in Hangzhou and continues SMI’s role in linking researchers, developers, students, and practitioners across geometry processing, modeling, and application areas. The conference welcomes original work in shape modeling and applications, and emphasizes reproducibility through participation in the Replicability Stamp Initiative. AR/VR environments; acquisition and reconstruction; behavior and animation models; compression and streaming; computational topology; correspondence and registration; curves and surfaces; digital fabrication and 3D printing; geometric deep learning; shape collections, feature extraction and classification; healing and resampling; implicit surfaces; interactive modeling, design, and editing; learning techniques for shape modeling; medial and skeletal representations; parametric and procedural models; segmentation; semantics; shape analysis and synthesis; applications in design, biomedicine, GIS, geoscience, art, cultural heritage, gaming, and education; shape statistics; deformation; simulation; 3D retrieval and digital twins.

postings.conferenceName: ACM Symposium on Cloud Computing 2026 2026
postings.conferenceText: SoCC 2026 is the ACM Symposium on Cloud Computing, a premier research conference dedicated to cloud computing systems, data infrastructure, and large-scale services. As the only conference co-sponsored by ACM SIGMOD and SIGOPS, the series sits at the intersection of data management and systems, bringing together work on the design, implementation, evaluation, and operation of cloud platforms and cloud-native applications. The 2026 edition takes place in Singapore as an in-person event. The symposium covers cloud platforms, datacenter systems, storage and data services, distributed execution, resource management, multi-tenant infrastructure, serverless and cloud-native systems, reliability and observability, security and privacy in the cloud, performance engineering, AI/ML workloads in cloud environments, and practical experience reports on cloud systems and services. The 2026 call uses two submission rounds; this record lists the first-round abstract and paper deadlines.

postings.conferenceName: 42nd International Symposium on Computational Geometry 2026
postings.conferenceText: SoCG, the International Symposium on Computational Geometry, is the anchor event of CG Week and the premier international forum for advances in computational geometry and its applications. The 2026 meeting is held at Rutgers University in New Brunswick as part of CG Week, which also includes media, young researcher, challenge, and workshop events. The conference highlights both theoretical and practical aspects of geometry and topology, and the 2026 call explicitly encourages work on implementation, engineering, experimentation, and applications alongside core algorithmic and mathematical contributions. Computational geometry and topology; geometry, topology, algorithms, and applications; practical aspects including implementation, engineering, experimentation, and applications; lightweight double-blind submissions; formal proceedings versions plus reproducibility expectations; associated CG Week workshops and community events.

postings.conferenceName: ACM-SIAM Symposium on Discrete Algorithms 2027
postings.conferenceText: SODA 2027 is the ACM-SIAM Symposium on Discrete Algorithms, a premier venue for research on the design, analysis, and applications of discrete algorithms. The symposium is a central meeting point for the algorithms community and regularly features contributions spanning theory, optimization, graph algorithms, randomized methods, and algorithmic applications. The 2027 edition is scheduled as an in-person event in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The symposium covers discrete algorithms broadly, including algorithm design and analysis, combinatorial optimization, graph algorithms, approximation, randomized algorithms, online and streaming computation, algorithmic game theory, data structures, and theoretical advances with practical algorithmic impact.

postings.conferenceName: 32nd SolarPACES Conference 2026
postings.conferenceText: SolarPACES 2026 is the 32nd edition of the long-running SolarPACES conference series, an international forum focused on concentrating solar thermal technologies and related thermal and solar-chemical energy systems. The official conference announcement describes a broad technical scope that spans research, engineering development, industrial deployment and market integration. The meeting brings together researchers, plant developers, manufacturers, operators, and policy-oriented participants working on solar thermal power generation, storage, hybrid systems, process heat and emerging solar fuel applications. As a specialized series with a strong international community, SolarPACES plays an important role in advancing engineering solutions for dispatchable solar energy and high-temperature renewable heat. Concentrating solar thermal power and power cycles; collectors, receivers and thermal systems; thermal energy storage; operations and maintenance; simulation, modelling and digital tools including AI; hybrid systems and grid integration; solar process heat and desalination; market development, policy and commercial projects; solar resource assessment and measurement systems; advanced materials and coatings; solar fuels, solar chemistry and high-temperature thermochemical processes.

postings.conferenceName: 32nd Symposium on Operating Systems Principles 2026
postings.conferenceText: SOSP 2026 is the 32nd Symposium on Operating Systems Principles, one of the world’s premier forums for computer systems technology. The conference highlights significant advances in operating systems and closely related areas of systems research, often shaping the future of the field. The Prague edition continues SOSP’s tradition of presenting influential work on the principles, abstractions, and implementation of modern computing systems. Operating systems principles; distributed systems; storage and file systems; systems for cloud, networking, and data-intensive workloads; performance and scalability; reliability and fault tolerance; security and privacy in systems; innovative systems abstractions and implementation techniques.

postings.conferenceName: Symposium on Usable Privacy and Security 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: Symposium on Usable Privacy and Security
postings.conferenceText: SOUPS 2026 is the Symposium on Usable Privacy and Security, a major venue for research at the intersection of security, privacy, and human-centered computing. The conference emphasizes the design, evaluation, and deployment of systems that are secure and privacy-preserving while remaining understandable and usable by real people. SOUPS brings together researchers and practitioners studying human behavior, interfaces, policy, and technical mechanisms related to usable privacy and security. Usable security and privacy; human-centered security design; authentication and identity usability; privacy notices, consent, and disclosure; user mental models of security; behavior, risk perception, and decision making; safety for at-risk populations; socio-technical studies of privacy and security; measurement and evaluation of user-facing privacy and security tools.

postings.conferenceName: 38th ACM Symposium on Parallelism in Algorithms and Architectures 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 38th ACM Symposium on Parallelism in Algorithms and Architectures
postings.conferenceText: SPAA 2026 is the 38th ACM Symposium on Parallelism in Algorithms and Architectures, a major venue for parallel and distributed computation. The symposium brings together research on the theory, design, and implementation of parallel algorithms and the architectures that support them. The 2026 edition will be held in London, co-located with related events, and continues SPAA’s role in connecting algorithmic advances with system and architectural considerations. Parallel algorithms; concurrent and distributed computation; architectures for parallelism; theory and practice of scalable computation; algorithmic and architectural approaches to efficient parallel systems.

postings.conferenceName: 28th International Conference on Speech and Computer 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 28th International Conference on Speech and Computer
postings.conferenceText: SPECOM 2026 is the 28th International Conference on Speech and Computer and marks 30 years since the first SPECOM in 1996. The conference brings together researchers, linguists, and engineers working across speech science, speech and language technologies, human-computer interaction, forensics, voice disorders, and paralinguistics. The official website presents SPECOM as a long-running international forum with prior editions held in cities across Europe and Asia, and the 2026 edition continues this tradition in Ohrid, North Macedonia. The event emphasizes both foundational and applied research in speech and language science and positions itself at the intersection of systems, signals, and intelligent technologies. Accepted papers are to be published by Springer Nature in the LNCS/LNAI series, and the site notes that presenting authors may opt in for online presentation, while the main venue is Hotel Granit on Lake Ohrid. Speech and language processing; multimodal, interactive and embodied AI; paralinguistics, behavior and affective computing; deployment, trust and healthcare; speech science; speech and language technologies; human-computer interaction; forensics; voice disorders; intelligent technologies. The official site describes SPECOM as a venue for research in speech and computer-related disciplines and highlights four main topical clusters on the homepage: Speech & Language Processing; Multimodal, Interactive & Embodied AI; Paralinguistics, Behavior & Affective Computing; and Deployment, Trust & Healthcare. Papers are submitted electronically via EasyChair and accepted papers are published in Springer Nature’s LNCS/LNAI series.

postings.conferenceName: Symposium on Solid and Physical Modeling 2025
postings.conferenceSeries: Symposium on Solid and Physical Modeling
postings.conferenceText: SPM is an international conference series organized with the support of the Solid Modeling Association. The 2025 symposium is co-located with SMI in Hangzhou and focuses on all aspects of geometric and physical modeling, together with applications in design, analysis, manufacturing, biomedical and geophysical domains, digital entertainment, and beyond. The conference also serves as the venue for the 2025 Pierre Bézier Prize ceremony, reinforcing its role in the solid and physical modeling community. Solid and physical modeling; geometric and physical modeling; applications in design, analysis, manufacturing, biomedical and geophysical domains, digital entertainment, and related areas.

postings.conferenceName: 58th ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 58th ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing
postings.conferenceText: STOC 2026 is the 58th ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing, one of the flagship conferences in theoretical computer science. Sponsored by ACM SIGACT, the conference is a premier venue for foundational advances in algorithms, complexity, randomness, combinatorics, optimization, learning theory, cryptography, and related areas. The 2026 edition is held in Salt Lake City, Utah as part of a broader TheoryFest program with papers, posters, invited talks, tutorials, and workshops. Typical topics listed on the conference site include algorithms and data structures, computational complexity, randomness in computing, algorithmic graph theory and combinatorics, analysis of Boolean functions, approximation algorithms, cryptography, computational learning theory, continuous and discrete optimization, economics and computation, parallel and distributed algorithms, quantum computing, algorithmic coding theory, computational geometry and topology, computational logic, algebraic computation, and theoretical aspects of machine learning, fairness, privacy, networks, data management, databases, and computational biology.

postings.conferenceName: 23rd Theory of Cryptography Conference 2025
postings.conferenceText: TCC 2025 is the 23rd Theory of Cryptography Conference, one of the central venues for foundational cryptography research. Organized under the IACR, TCC emphasizes the conceptual and mathematical underpinnings of cryptographic systems, protocols, and security notions. The conference serves as a forum for results on both established and emerging areas of theoretical cryptography. Foundations of cryptography; secure computation; zero-knowledge and proof systems; hardness assumptions; pseudorandomness; encryption and signatures; cryptographic protocols; information-theoretic and computational security; quantum and post-quantum theory; rigorous analysis of cryptographic constructions and models.

postings.conferenceName: TMS 2026 Annual Meeting & Exhibition 2026
postings.conferenceText: TMS 2026 Annual Meeting & Exhibition is the annual flagship event of The Minerals, Metals & Materials Society and a major international forum for researchers and professionals across minerals, metals, and materials. The 2026 edition will take place in San Diego, California and is positioned as a large-scale meeting that convenes thousands of attendees from academia, national laboratories, and industry. The event is organized through a broad set of technical symposia and programming tracks spanning structural materials, functional materials, extraction and processing, manufacturing, modeling, energy-related materials, and professional practice. Its scope makes it a key venue for developments in metallurgy, materials engineering, manufacturing, and related applications. Minerals, metals and materials research; extraction and processing; structural and functional materials; light metals and alloys; additive manufacturing and processing technologies; computational materials engineering and modeling; characterization and performance; energy materials; recycling and sustainability; manufacturing innovation; and broad professional and technical symposia presented under the TMS annual meeting program.

postings.conferenceName: Traditional Med 2027
postings.conferenceSeries: 10th Edition of International Conference on Traditional Medicine and Integrative Health
postings.conferenceText: The 10th Edition of International Conference on Traditional Medicine and Integrative Health bridges traditional medicine and modern healthcare in Rome and Online from June 24-26, 2027, with sixteen tracks over three days. Coordinated by Magnus Group LLC, the meeting draws scholars, cultural practitioners, herbal-medicine experts, and clinical professionals into shared conversation. Sessions extend across Traditional Chinese Medicine, Ayurveda, acupuncture, herbal medicine, and mind-body therapies within a focused three-day programme. Organised as a CPD-accredited three-day meeting at NH Villa Carpegna, Rome (June 24-26, 2027), the 10th Edition of International Conference on Traditional Medicine and Integrative Health (Traditional Med 2027) gives the international traditional-medicine and integrative-health community a working forum for scholarly briefings, cultural-medicine sessions, and case-based discussion. Every part of the programme is directed at bringing traditional knowledge and clinical evidence together in ways that benefit scholars, practitioners, and public-health professionals. Coverage at this Holistic Medicine Conference 2027 reaches across Traditional Chinese Medicine, Ayurveda, acupuncture, herbal medicine, phytotherapy, mind-body therapies, yoga and meditation, aromatherapy and music therapy, biofeedback mechanisms, natural therapies, holistic treatment, cultural preservation in medicine, modern-healthcare integration, and global-health integration. Delegates and presenters at the conference are issued a CPD certificate of attendance; oral or poster abstracts that pass review add further academic recognition. Within the Traditional Medicine Conferences 2027 calendar, this meeting operates a tiered registration model - abstract submission for speakers and presenters, standard or early-bird rates for delegates and listeners. postings.conferenceName: 23rd International Workshop on Trust, Privacy and Security in the Digital Society 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 23rd International Workshop on Trust, Privacy and Security in the Digital Society
postings.conferenceText: TrustBus 2026 is the 23rd International Workshop on Trust, Privacy and Security in the Digital Society and will be held in conjunction with ARES 2026. The official workshop page describes TrustBus as a long-running international and interdisciplinary forum, with a series dating back to 2004, where researchers and practitioners exchange advances in the state of the art and practice of trust, privacy, and security. The 2026 edition frames its scope in the context of a rapidly evolving digital society shaped by generative AI, cloud and edge computing, and the Internet of Things. The workshop emphasizes both technical innovation and the broader societal, legal, and regulatory environment in which digital trust and security challenges arise. As a co-located workshop within ARES, it sits at the intersection of dependable systems, privacy protection, and secure digital services. Accountability, transparency and intervenability; anonymity and pseudonymity; common practices, legal and regulatory issues; detecting and preventing digital misinformation; economics of cyber security and privacy; identity management, identity theft and trust management; information audit and trust; reliable auction, e-procurement and negotiation technology; security and privacy for cloud and edge computing; security and privacy in data governance and management; security and privacy patterns and antipatterns; security, privacy and trust for digital society services; security, privacy and trust in mobile environments; supply chain cyber security; trust and reputation for digital societies; trustworthy AI; usability of security and privacy technologies and services.

postings.conferenceName: 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence
postings.conferenceText: UAI 2026 is the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence, a premier conference devoted to knowledge representation, learning, and reasoning under uncertainty. Since 1985, the series has brought together the community working on probabilistic reasoning, causal inference, structured models, decision making, and statistically grounded AI methods. The 2026 edition takes place in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with tutorials and workshops surrounding the main conference. The conference focuses on uncertainty in artificial intelligence, including probabilistic modeling, Bayesian methods, causal reasoning, decision making, inference and learning under uncertainty, structured representations, and related theoretical and application-driven advances.

postings.conferenceName: UbiComp / ISWC 2026 2026
postings.conferenceText: UbiComp / ISWC 2026 is the joint conference for ubiquitous computing and wearable computing, bringing together the communities behind two influential ACM conference series. The event covers the design, implementation, and study of technologies embedded in everyday environments, devices, and interactions, from pervasive sensing to human-centered wearable systems. The 2026 edition in Shanghai continues the joint conference’s role as a hub for innovative, interdisciplinary work spanning systems, interaction, health, intelligence, and real-world deployment. Ubiquitous and pervasive computing; wearable computing and sensing; mobile and context-aware systems; IoT and smart environments; human-centered AI in everyday settings; health, wellbeing and assistive technologies; privacy, ethics and trust in ubiquitous systems; interaction techniques and user studies; real-world deployments and longitudinal evaluations.

postings.conferenceName: ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology
postings.conferenceText: UIST 2026 is the ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology, a premier forum for innovations in human-computer interfaces. The symposium showcases advances in the software and hardware of interactive systems, including novel interaction techniques, input/output technologies, toolkits, and applied interface systems. The 2026 edition in Detroit continues UIST’s strong tradition of presenting influential, forward-looking work on interactive technologies. User interface software and technology; innovative interaction techniques; hardware and sensing for interfaces; toolkits and systems for interactive computing; novel input/output methods; prototyping, design, and evaluation of next-generation interactive technologies.

postings.conferenceName: 61st International Universities Power Engineering Conference 2026
postings.conferenceText: The 61st International Universities Power Engineering Conference (UPEC 2026) is a long-running international forum on electric power engineering hosted by the University of Cagliari. The 2026 conference is framed around the theme “Bridging Power Engineering Heritage and the AI-Driven Energy Future,” positioning the event as a venue for both classical and emerging topics in modern power systems. UPEC traditionally gathers researchers, academics, students, and industry participants working across power generation, transmission, distribution, power electronics, system operation, and digital energy technologies. The conference particularly emphasizes the interaction between established power engineering methods and newer developments such as artificial intelligence, data-driven operation, flexible energy systems, and resilient pathways toward a carbon-neutral energy future. Artificial intelligence in power system operation; planning, control and forecasting; intelligent management of grids and distributed energy resources; resilience, flexibility and sustainability of energy systems; conventional and renewable power engineering; smart grids; power electronics; system analysis, operation and optimization; future low-carbon electricity infrastructures and AI-enabled energy technologies.

postings.conferenceName: 36th USENIX Security Symposium 2027
postings.conferenceText: The 36th USENIX Security Symposium is a flagship venue for advances in the security and privacy of computer systems and networks. The symposium brings together research on attacks, defenses, secure systems design, privacy technologies, and the empirical study of security in practice. The 2027 edition is scheduled in Denver, Colorado and continues the USENIX Security tradition as one of the most influential conferences in computer security. The symposium broadly covers systems and network security, privacy, applied cryptography, software and hardware security, web and mobile security, secure machine learning, measurement studies, usable security, offensive and defensive techniques, and practical evaluations of security and privacy technologies. The homepage lists two submission cycles; this record captures cycle 1.

postings.conferenceName: 53rd International Conference on Very Large Data Bases 2027
postings.conferenceSeries: 53rd International Conference on Very Large Data Bases
postings.conferenceText: VLDB 2027 is the 53rd International Conference on Very Large Data Bases, one of the flagship conferences in data management. The conference advances the state of the art in data systems, data-intensive applications, and large-scale information processing, and has a long history of publishing influential work at the intersection of theory, systems, and practice. The 2027 edition in Athens continues VLDB’s role as a major international venue for innovations in modern data infrastructure. Database systems; data processing at scale; query optimization and execution; cloud and distributed data management; graph, streaming and spatial data; analytics and data science systems; data management for machine learning and AI; transaction processing and consistency; data integration and information quality; privacy, security and responsible data systems.

postings.conferenceName: 27th International Conference on Verification, Model Checking, and Abstract Interpretation 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 27th International Conference on Verification, Model Checking, and Abstract Interpretation
postings.conferenceText: VMCAI 2026 is the 27th International Conference on Verification, Model Checking, and Abstract Interpretation. The conference provides a forum for researchers from the verification, model checking, and abstract interpretation communities, with a strong emphasis on connections between formal reasoning techniques and practical analysis methods. Co-located with POPL, VMCAI covers sound static and dynamic methods for analyzing programs and systems. Verification; model checking; abstract interpretation; static and dynamic analysis; program semantics; formal reasoning about software and systems; hybrid analysis methods; tool support for rigorous analysis.

postings.conferenceName: The IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision 2026 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: The IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision 2026
postings.conferenceText: WACV is a premier international computer vision conference organized by the IEEE Computer Society and the Computer Vision Foundation. The 2026 edition is held in Tucson, Arizona and combines the main conference with co-located workshops, tutorials, demos, a doctoral consortium, and poster activities. The conference emphasizes high-quality, high-impact work in applications of computer vision, giving students, academic researchers, and industry practitioners a focused venue for presenting new results, discussing emerging directions, and engaging with the broader vision community. Computer vision research and applications; vision systems and real-world deployments; visual recognition and scene understanding; detection, segmentation, tracking, and video analysis; 3D vision, geometry, and multimodal perception; open review paper tracks with workshops, tutorials, demos, and doctoral consortium contributions.

postings.conferenceName: IEEE Wireless Communications and Networking Conference 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: IEEE Wireless Communications and Networking Conference
postings.conferenceText: IEEE WCNC is a flagship conference of the IEEE Communications Society and a top-ranked venue for wireless communications and networking research. The 2026 edition is hosted in Kuala Lumpur and features a comprehensive in-person program including technical papers, workshops, tutorials, panels, keynote speeches, and industry exhibits. The conference is aimed at researchers from academia, industry, and government working on cutting-edge technologies, applications, and services across wireless systems and networks. Wireless communications and networking; technical papers; workshops; tutorials; panel proposals; submission guidelines for communications systems, networking technologies, applications, and services across modern wireless ecosystems.

postings.conferenceName: The 9th Annual World Congress of Smart Materials 2025
postings.conferenceSeries: The 9th Annual World Congress of Smart Materials
postings.conferenceText: The 9th Annual World Congress of Smart Materials (WCSM-2025) is an international congress dedicated to the design, development, engineering, and applications of smart materials. The official site positions smart materials as an important direction within advanced high-technology materials research and presents the congress as a platform for exchange between academia, research institutes, and industry. The 2025 edition will be held in Osaka, Japan and is organized through multiple thematic forums that cover both core materials science and practical applications. The congress aims to encourage interdisciplinary dialogue on how smart materials can enable future technologies in manufacturing, optics, electronics, energy, environment, biomedicine, and intelligent structures. Forum themes include smart materials engineering, mechanical and manufacturing topics; smart optical, electronic and magnetic materials; smart materials for energy and environment; smart biomaterials and bio-engineering; smart materials and structures; and future trends and applications of smart materials. The program also covers related subtopics in design, synthesis, functionality, characterization, integration, devices, and application-driven development.

postings.conferenceName: WEFTEC 2026 – 99th Annual Technical Exhibition & Conference 2026
postings.conferenceText: WEFTEC is the flagship annual technical exhibition and conference of the Water Environment Federation and is one of the most established international events in the water and wastewater sector. The 2026 edition in New Orleans continues the long-running series as its 99th annual meeting. The conference brings together utility professionals, engineers, technology providers, researchers, operators, regulators and consultants to exchange practical and research-driven advances in water quality management, wastewater treatment, resource recovery, infrastructure, operations, and environmental protection. The official programme highlights workshops, technical sessions, facility tours, and continuing education opportunities, reflecting WEFTEC’s role as a major forum for professional training, technology demonstration, and discussion of emerging issues in water environment engineering. Water quality and wastewater engineering; treatment processes and plant operations; collection systems and sewer infrastructure; residuals, biosolids and resource recovery; stormwater and wet weather management; utility management and asset planning; environmental compliance and regulation; process control, digitalization and monitoring; facility tours, workshops, posters and technical sessions related to the water environment field.

postings.conferenceName: 25th World Hydrogen Energy Conference 2026
postings.conferenceText: The 25th World Hydrogen Energy Conference (WHEC 2026) is an established international conference series dedicated to the hydrogen economy and the engineering, science and policy required for large-scale deployment of hydrogen technologies. The 2026 edition in Singapore brings together researchers, industry leaders, policy specialists and technology developers to discuss how hydrogen can support decarbonization, industrial transformation and resilient energy systems. The official programme emphasizes cross-sector collaboration and addresses the full hydrogen value chain, from production and infrastructure to safety, utilization, economics and regional deployment. As a global hydrogen conference with a long history, WHEC functions as a major forum for linking fundamental advances with practical implementation and market creation. Hydrogen production, electrolysis and alternative pathways; hydrogen transport, storage and distribution; fuel cells and hydrogen end-use applications; safety, standards and codes; systems integration and energy infrastructure; techno-economics, commercialization and policy; materials, components and manufacturing for hydrogen technologies; mobility and transport applications; industrial decarbonization; regional hydrogen deployment strategies and broader hydrogen economy development topics organized under the official WHEC topic groups.

postings.conferenceName: 19th EAI International Conference on Wireless Internet 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 19th EAI International Conference on Wireless Internet
postings.conferenceText: WiCON 2026 is the 19th EAI International Conference on Wireless Internet. The conference focuses on architectures, protocols, systems, and applications for wireless and mobile Internet technologies, connecting networking foundations with evolving service and platform needs. The 2026 edition in Bratislava continues the conference’s emphasis on practical and research advances in pervasive wireless connectivity, network intelligence, and future communication environments. Wireless Internet architectures; mobile and cellular networking; IoT and sensor networks; edge and pervasive wireless systems; routing, mobility and protocol design; performance, management and optimization; security and privacy in wireless Internet; AI/ML for wireless networking; emerging applications over mobile and wireless platforms.

postings.conferenceName: 19th ACM Conference on Security and Privacy in Wireless and Mobile Networks 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 19th ACM Conference on Security and Privacy in Wireless and Mobile Networks
postings.conferenceText: WiSec 2026 is the 19th ACM Conference on Security and Privacy in Wireless and Mobile Networks. The conference is a leading venue for research on security and privacy issues in wireless communications, mobile systems, IoT, cyber-physical environments, and related applications. Hosted by CISPA in Saarbrücken, WiSec combines foundational methods with practical defenses and system-building work relevant to contemporary networked platforms. Wireless and mobile security; cellular and network protocol security; IoT and cyber-physical systems security; privacy in mobile and wireless systems; applied cryptography for wireless settings; authentication and access control; usable security and privacy; biometrics; attacks, measurements, and defenses for connected devices and platforms.

postings.conferenceText: This official conference site presents a combined materials event consisting of the 3rd World Materials Conference (WMC 2025), the 9th World Materials Summit (WMS 2025), and the 26th International Conference in Asia of the International Union of Materials Research Societies (IUMRS-ICA 2025). Hosted in Guilin, China, the meeting is organized around international exchange in advanced materials research and development, with participation from the broader global materials community. The conference and summit format brings together academic presentations, strategic discussion on the future of materials science and engineering, and cross-regional collaboration among major materials research organizations. The event is positioned as a broad platform covering leading topics across modern materials research, innovation, and applications. Advanced materials research and engineering; international materials collaboration; structural and functional materials; energy and environmental materials; electronic and optical materials; biomaterials and soft materials; materials processing and manufacturing; materials characterization; frontier materials technologies; strategic summit discussions on materials innovation and future directions; and technical sessions associated with the WMC, WMS and IUMRS-ICA programs.

postings.conferenceText: WoWMoM is a long-running IEEE symposium for researchers and practitioners interested in wireless, mobile, and multimedia pervasive communications. The 2026 edition in Bologna features paper presentations, keynote speeches, hot-topic panels, workshops, and a postgraduate forum, with accepted papers considered for inclusion in IEEE Xplore. The conference focuses on wireless networking technologies and their role in future Internet scenarios, especially the delivery, sharing, and management of multimedia content over mobile and wireless systems. Wireless networking technologies; mobile and multimedia pervasive communications; future Internet scenarios; multimedia delivery over wireless networks; context-aware services; mobile users and user-generated content; experimental systems, simulations, analyses, deployments, testbeds, and field trials in academia and industry.

postings.conferenceName: The ACM Web Conference 2026 2026
postings.conferenceText: The ACM Web Conference 2026, formerly known as the International World Wide Web Conference (WWW), is the premier annual forum for presenting and discussing advances in research, development, standards, and applications shaping the future of the Web. Since 1989, the conference series has served as a central meeting place for the web research community. The 2026 edition is held in Dubai, United Arab Emirates and features research sessions, posters and demos, a PhD symposium, workshops, tutorials, special tracks, industry activities, keynote talks, panels, and the co-located Web4All event. The conference broadly addresses web research, development, standards, and applications, including web systems, information access, social and semantic web technologies, web mining, data-driven web applications, user interaction, industry and deployment issues, and the broader technologies shaping the evolution of the Web.
